name: Omackup
author: gravey
description: Incremental restic backups of personal files to USB, NAS, and cloud, with a floating restore browser.

barWidget.description: Back up personal files and restore them from USB, NAS, or cloud.

schema.label: Notify when any file is unbacked up
schema.description: Send a desktop notification as soon as a selected file is new or changed.

schema.label: Notify when unbacked-up files are older than a set time
schema.description: Send a desktop notification after unbacked-up changes have sat for a while.

schema.label: Notify when an automatic backup is missed
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a scheduled backup did not run.

schema.label: RGB loading bar
schema.description: Turn it off for a boring loading bar.

schema.label: 24-hour time
schema.description: Show last-updated times as 15:04 instead of 3:04 PM.
